newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.140PTS TO 102.837.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX FALLS 0.140PTS TO 102.837.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.140 points in Monday's trading to 102.837, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose by 0.012 points to 2.238 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.099 points to 99.200, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio grew by 0.033 points to 2.198 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 6.194 points to 1,050.439.
